name: QR Code & Barcode Scanner
tagline: Read QR codes and barcodes locally from image bytes with one Rust-backed scanner.
description: Use QR Code AI's local scanner to inspect a label, verify a QR design or read QR and Code 128 values from the same image. The pinned MCP adapter 0.2.1 uses scanner engine 0.11.0 and exposes scan_image, which accepts base64 image bytes and returns decoded text, symbology, base64 payload bytes and detection positions in a JSON report. Choose fast, frame or full scanning profiles. Image decoding runs locally. QR Code AI also plans a [QR code image scanner](https://qrcode-ai.com/en-US/qr-code-scanner) and a [barcode image scanner](https://qrcode-ai.com/en-US/barcode-scanner) for browser workflows.

install.notes: Requires Node.js 22.19+ on the 22 line, or Node.js 24+. Supply canonical base64 image bytes through imageBase64. See the linked MCP README for scan_image arguments, supported native platforms, input limits and the packaged report schema. Treat decoded URLs and text as untrusted data.
